name: initial_tables
statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}clusters`(id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,data LONGTEXT NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}plans`(id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,data LONGTEXT NOT NULL,seq BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT UNIQUE) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}runs`(id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,data LONGTEXT NOT NULL,INDEX runs_status_time(status,created_at)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}reports`(id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,run_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,data LONGTEXT NOT NULL,INDEX reports_run(run_id,created_at)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}idempotency`(kind VARCHAR(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,`key` VARBINARY(800) NOT NULL,digest CHAR(64) NOT NULL,object_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(kind,`key`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}sessions`(id CHAR(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,csrf VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,expires DOUBLE NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}instances`(id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,role VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,heartbeat_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,heartbeat_epoch DOUBLE NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}audit`(id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,action VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,object_id VARCHAR(101)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}projects`(id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,data LONGTEXT NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}workflows`(id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,revision BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,deleted TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,updated_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,payload LONGTEXT NOT NULL,INDEX active_updated(deleted,updated_at)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}api_collections`(id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,revision BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,deleted TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,updated_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,payload LONGTEXT NOT NULL,INDEX active_updated(deleted,updated_at)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}environments`(id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,revision BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,deleted TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,updated_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,payload LONGTEXT NOT NULL,INDEX active_updated(deleted,updated_at)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}workflow_versions`(id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,object_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,revision BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,payload LONGTEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE KEY object_revision(object_id,revision)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}api_collection_versions`(id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,object_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,revision BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,payload LONGTEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE KEY object_revision(object_id,revision)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}plan_workflow_links`(id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,plan_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,workflow_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,workflow_revision BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,relation VARCHAR(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,UNIQUE KEY exact_source(plan_id,workflow_id,workflow_revision,relation),INDEX plan_source(plan_id,created_at),INDEX workflow_source(workflow_id,workflow_revision,created_at)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}webhook_deliveries`(event_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,run_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL UNIQUE,target_url TEXT NOT NULL,payload LONGTEXT NOT NULL,status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,attempts INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,next_attempt_at DOUBLE NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,lease_token VARCHAR(101) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',lease_until DOUBLE NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,last_status_code INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,last_error VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,INDEX webhook_due(status,next_attempt_at,lease_until)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}workflow_datasets`(id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,project_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,workflow_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,node_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,deleted TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,data LONGTEXT NOT NULL,INDEX node_files(project_id,workflow_id,node_id,deleted)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}task_dispatches`(id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,project_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,attempts INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,next_attempt_at DOUBLE NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,payload LONGTEXT NOT NULL,last_error VARCHAR(100),INDEX dispatch_pending(status,next_attempt_at)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}runner_events`(id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,task_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,digest CHAR(64) NOT NULL,INDEX task_events(task_id)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}pressure_reports`(id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,project_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,run_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,version INT NOT NULL,status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,finished_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',identity_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL,verdict_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NOT_SET',sample_count BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,success_count BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,mean_ms DOUBLE NULL,min_ms DOUBLE NULL,max_ms DOUBLE NULL,p50_ms DOUBLE NULL,p90_ms DOUBLE NULL,bytes_received BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,bytes_sent BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,transaction_count BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,sample_scope VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sample_records',failure_count BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,success_rate DOUBLE NULL,rps DOUBLE NULL,p95_ms DOUBLE NULL,p99_ms DOUBLE NULL,duration_seconds DOUBLE NULL,data LONGTEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE KEY report_version(run_id,version),UNIQUE KEY report_identity(run_id,identity_hash),INDEX report_scope(project_id,created_at),INDEX report_run(run_id,status,version)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}pressure_report_jobs`(id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,project_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,run_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,attempts INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,next_attempt_at DOUBLE NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,lease_until DOUBLE NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,lease_token VARCHAR(101) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',last_error VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',INDEX report_job_due(status,next_attempt_at)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}pressure_report_sources`(id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,project_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,report_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,position INT NOT NULL,kind VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',label VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',count_value BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,number_value DOUBLE NULL,data LONGTEXT NOT NULL,name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,bucket VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,object_key VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL,sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,size BIGINT NOT NULL,valid_rows BIGINT NOT NULL,invalid_rows BIGINT NOT NULL,INDEX report_children(project_id,report_id,position)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}pressure_report_steps`(id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,project_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,report_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,position INT NOT NULL,kind VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',label VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',count_value BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,number_value DOUBLE NULL,data LONGTEXT NOT NULL,sample_kind VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,sample_count BIGINT NOT NULL,failure_count BIGINT NOT NULL,success_rate DOUBLE NULL,mean_ms DOUBLE NULL,p95_ms DOUBLE NULL,p99_ms DOUBLE NULL,INDEX report_children(project_id,report_id,position)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}pressure_report_timeline`(id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,project_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,report_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,position INT NOT NULL,kind VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',label VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',count_value BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,number_value DOUBLE NULL,data LONGTEXT NOT NULL,timestamp_ms BIGINT NOT NULL,width_ms BIGINT NOT NULL,sample_count BIGINT NOT NULL,failure_count BIGINT NOT NULL,rps DOUBLE NULL,mean_ms DOUBLE NULL,p95_ms DOUBLE NULL,INDEX report_children(project_id,report_id,position)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}pressure_report_issues`(id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,project_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,report_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,position INT NOT NULL,kind VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',label VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',count_value BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,number_value DOUBLE NULL,data LONGTEXT NOT NULL,source_kind VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,source_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,category VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,level VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,message TEXT NOT NULL,first_at BIGINT NULL,last_at BIGINT NULL,line_from BIGINT NOT NULL,line_to BIGINT NOT NULL,INDEX report_children(project_id,report_id,position)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}pressure_report_metrics`(id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,project_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,report_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,position INT NOT NULL,kind VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',label VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',count_value BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,number_value DOUBLE NULL,data LONGTEXT NOT NULL,metric_key VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,origin VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,schema_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,INDEX report_children(project_id,report_id,position)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}pressure_report_findings`(id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,project_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,report_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,position INT NOT NULL,kind VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',label VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',count_value BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,number_value DOUBLE NULL,data LONGTEXT NOT NULL,origin VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,level VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,INDEX report_children(project_id,report_id,position)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
